mapper.sql: FROM task_assignment a JOIN task t ON t.id=a.task_id AND t.user_id=a.user_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN stage s ON s.id=t.stage_id AND s.user_id=a.user_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN goal g ON g.id=s.goal_id AND g.user_id=a.user_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN weekly_plan w ON w.id=a.weekly_plan_id AND w.user_id=a.user_id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN daily_plan d ON d.id=a.daily_plan_id AND d.user_id=a.user_id AND d.weekly_plan_id=w.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} AND a.ended_at IS NULL AND (a.daily_plan_id IS NULL OR d.id IS NOT NULL) AND a.weekly_plan_id=#{q.weeklyPlanId} AND a.daily_plan_id=#{q.dailyPlanId} AND g.id=#{q.goalId}AND s.id=#{q.stageId} AND t.name ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' AND t.status=#{q.status} AND COALESCE(d.plan_date,w.week_start_date) >= #{q.dateFrom} AND COALESCE(d.plan_date,w.week_start_date+6) <= #{q.dateTo} AND t.status<>'COMPLETED' AND g.archived_at IS NULL AND (d.plan_date < #{q.today} OR w.week_start_date+6 < #{q.today})
